verdict.rationale: The Cactus engine documents automatic routing of hard queries to the cloud based on local model confidence, and a community user built on 'Cactus Hybrid', so cloud and local inference do coexist behind one API. The evidence never names which cloud providers are supported, how to configure them, or whether users can pick a cloud model manually, so the 'power-user connects to providers' part is thin. Missing for 10: documented list of supported cloud providers (e.g., OpenAI/Anthropic keys), manual provider/model selection in the same interface, configuration docs, independent hands-on corroboration of the cloud routing.
